cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤

2 7" 4+ 8
折磨手雷 1AP
选择一名位于该特工 6" 内且对其可见的敌方特
工。那名特工以及其 1" 内的每一名其他特工需要
进行一次中毒测试。
在进行中毒测试时，掷一枚 D6，如果特工的豁免
属性为 4+ 或更差，那么掷骰结果增加 1 点：若结
果为 3+，对那名特工造成 D3 点伤害，并且获得
一枚己方的中毒标识（如果特工原先没有这个标识
的话)。每当一枚拥有己方中毒标识的特工被激活
时，对其造成 D3 点伤害。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
KABALITE DISCIPLE OF YAELINDRA
2 7" 4+ 8
TORMENT GRENADE 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to and within 6" of this
operative. That operative and each other operative within 1"
of it takes a poison test.
For an operative to take a poison test, roll one D6, adding 1
to the result if that operative has a Save stat of 4+ or worse:
on a 3+, inflict D3 damage on that operative and it gains
one of your Poison tokens (if it doesn’t already have one).
Whenever an operative that has one of your Poison tokens is
activated, inflict D3 damage on it.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

预示：在选择特工步骤中，您可以选择装备时，您
可以选择一名敌方特工或者另一名己方执政官之手
特工（在您揭示装备时揭示您的选择)。在为那名特

• 如果选择的是一名敌方特工，那么您的对手必须

• 如果选择的是一名己方特工，那么您可以重掷任

标记 1AP
选择一名对该特工可见的敌方特工。直到转折点
结束前，每当该特工对那名敌方特工进行射击
时，您可以使用本效果。若使用：
• 该特工的远程武器拥有“追踪轻型”武器规则。
• 那名敌方特工不能被遮挡。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
KABALITE SKYSPLINTER ASSASSIN
2 7" 4+ 8
Omen: In the Select Operatives step, when you’re selecting
equipment, you can select one enemy operative or one other
friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operative (reveal your
selection when you reveal equipment). Whenever attack or
defence dice are rolled for that operative:
• If it’s an enemy operative, your opponent must re-roll their
dice results of 6.
• If it’s a friendly operative, you can re-roll any of your dice
results of 1.
MARK 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the
end of the turning point, whenever this operative is shooting
that enemy operative you can use this effect. If you do:
• This operative’s ranged weapons have the Seek Light
weapon rule.
• That enemy operative cannot be obscured.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营规则
痛苦之力
黑暗灵族吸食着被杀者与受折磨者的灵魂，
从亲手造成的痛苦之中得到滋养。
在一名己方执政官之手特工执行行动后，如果
满足以下条件，则获得一枚己方痛苦指示物：
• 一名敌方特工在那次行动期间受创，但是没有
被残废。
• 一名敌方特工在那次行动期间被残废。如果那
名敌方特工的耐伤属性大于等于 12，那么己方
特工则获得两枚痛苦指示物。
在满足了激励的“时机”条件后，您可以消耗己
方特工的痛苦指示物来进行激励。您在每次激活
或反应中不能使用超过一种激励，“感官刺激”
除外，它可以在行动和反应期间与其他激励一同
使用一次。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION RULE
POWER FROM PAIN
The Drukhari feed on the souls of their slain and
tortured victims, drawing sustenance from the terrible
agonies they inflict.
After a friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operative
performs an action, it gains one of your Pain
tokens if:
• An enemy operative was injured during that
action, but was not incapacitated.
• An enemy operative was incapacitated during
that action. If that enemy operative had a
Wounds stat of 12 or more, that friendly
operative gains two of your Pain tokens instead.
You can spend friendly operatives’ Pain tokens on
invigorations when the ‘when’ condition is met.
You cannot use more than one invigoration per
activation or counteraction, except Stimulated
Senses, which can be used once per activation or
counteraction in addition to another invigoration.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
激励
黑暗仇恨
时机：在特工的激活期间，执行行动之前或之后。
效果：直到特工的下一次激活开始前，其 APL
属性增加 1 点。
加速恢复
时机：在特工的激活或反应期间，执行行动之前
或之后。
效果：特工回复最多 D3+1 点失去的耐伤。
活力激发
时机：在特工残废一名敌方特工后，且那名敌方
特工被移出杀戮区。
效果：特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，
就算特工执行了阻止其执行冲刺行动的行动。
感官刺激
时机：在您为特工掷攻击或防御骰之后。
效果：您可以重掷任何指定结果的骰子（例如结
果为 2 的骰子)。
cards.text_en:
INVIGORATIONS
Dark Animus
When: During the operative’s activation, before or
after it performs an action.
Effect: Until the start of the operative’s next
activation, add 1 to its APL stat.
Accelerated Rejuvenation
When: During the operative’s activation or
counteraction, before or after it performs
an action.
Effect: The operative regains up to D3+1
lost wounds.
Vitalised Surge
When: After the operative incapacitates an
enemy operative and that enemy operative is
removed from the killzone.
Effect: The operative can immediately perform a
free Dash action, even if it’s performed an action
that prevents it from performing the Dash action.
Stimulated Senses
When: After rolling your attack or defence dice for
the operative.
Effect: You can re-roll any of your dice results of
one result (e.g. results of 2).

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营规则
步枪
阴谋团战士们所配备的长管毒晶步枪在专家
的手中极其精准。
每当一名己方执政官之手特工在没有执行冲
锋、后撤或转移行动的激活中使用毒晶步枪进行
射击时，那件武器拥有“精准 1”武器规则。请
注意，这并不会限制特工在射击之后执行上述的
行动。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION RULE
RIFLES
The long-barrelled splinter rifles carried by Kabalite
Warriors are incredibly accurate in the hands of a
skilled user.
Whenever a friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON
operative is shooting with a splinter rifle during
an activation in which it hasn’t performed the
Charge, Fall Back or Reposition action, that
weapon has the Accurate 1 weapon rule. Note
that operative isn’t restricted from performing
those actions after shooting.

预兆激越药痛苦使者

cards.text:
执政官之手
战略计谋
刀艺师
黑暗灵族将近战肉搏化作血腥的艺术，使用
剥皮攻击和穿心突刺将敌人屠杀。
己方执政官之手特工的近战武器拥有“撕裂”
武器规则。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
STRATEGY PLOY
BLADE ARTISTS
The Drukhari have made a macabre art form of melee
combat, slaughtering their victims with flensing strikes
and heart-piercing thrusts.
Friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operatives'
melee weapons have the Rending weapon rule.

cards.text:
执政官之手
战略计谋
无情施虐者
黑暗灵族通过他人的痛苦来滋养自身，他们
毫无怜悯之心。对他们而言，没有任何折磨
手段是不能被利用的。
每当一名己方执政官之手特工对一名受伤的敌
方特工进行射击或近战时，那名己方特工的武器
拥有“平衡”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
STRATEGY PLOY
MERCILESS SADISTS
The Drukhari are sustained by the agony of others and
are devoid of pity. There is no act of depraved torture to
which they will not stoop.
Whenever a friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON
operative is shooting against or fighting against
a wounded enemy operative, that friendly
operative’s weapons have the Balanced
weapon rule.

cards.text:
执政官之手
战略计谋
死亡从暗中袭来
荣誉对黑暗灵族来说是一个陌生的概念。他
们会利用各种干扰和佯攻手段来欺骗敌人，
从暗中发起出其不意的攻击。
每当一名己方执政官之手特工被激活时，在您
决定它的命令前，您可以选择一名不属于那名己
方特工有效目标的敌方特工。直到那次激活结束
前，当那名己方特工首次对那名敌方特工进行射
击或近战时，您可以将一枚普通成功作为一次关
键成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
STRATEGY PLOY
FROM DARKNESS, DEATH
Honour is an alien concept to the Drukhari. They
make use of distraction and misdirection to butcher
unsuspecting foes from the shadows.
Whenever a friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON
operative is activated, before you determine its
order, you can select one enemy operative that
friendly operative isn’t a valid target for. Until the
end of that activation, the first time that friendly
operative is shooting against or fighting against
that enemy operative, you can retain one of your
normal successes as a critical success instead.

cards.text:
执政官之手
战略计谋
夜之住民
黑暗灵族来自于黑暗之城科摩罗，他们在黑
暗之中出生成长，能够利用黑暗来隐藏自己
的行动。
每当一名敌方特工对位于敌方特工 2" 外的己方
执政官之手特工进行射击时，如果有造成阻碍
的重型或轻型地形，或者那名己方特工的任意部
分位于制高点地形下方，那么您可以重掷一枚自
己的防御骰。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
STRATEGY PLOY
DENIZENS OF NIGHT
Hailing from Commorragh – the Dark City – the Drukhari
are born and raised in shadow, and use it to conceal
their movements.
Whenever an enemy operative is shooting a
friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operative that’s
more than 2" from enemy operatives, if Heavy
or Light terrain is intervening, or any part of that
friendly operative’s base is underneath Vantage
terrain, you can re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
执政官之手
交战计谋
残酷诡计
黑暗之城的住民们十分擅长欺诈与背叛。在
战斗之中，他们极为擅长发挥这项天赋，在
痛击敌人之后遁入暗影之中。
在一名己方执政官之手特工的激活期间，在其
执行一次行动之前或之后使用本交战计谋。在那
次激活期间，那名特工在执行后撤行动时可以少
消耗 1AP。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
CRUEL DECEPTION
The denizens of the Dark City are well versed in deceit
and betrayal. In battle, they put these talents to good
use, hitting their foes hard before melting away into
the shadows.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly HAND OF
THE ARCHON operative’s activation, before or
after it performs an action. During that activation,
that operative can perform the Fall Back action
for 1 less AP.

cards.text:
执政官之手
交战计谋
邪恶计划
黑暗灵族各个都是心怀鬼胎的阴谋家，他们
习惯于领先一步并战胜敌人的一举一动。
在对手使用了交战计谋后（消耗 0CP 的计谋除
外）使用本交战计谋。在对手下一次使用那个计
谋时，他们必须消耗额外 1CP 才能使用那个计
谋（在那之后，本效果结束)。直到本计谋的效
果结束前，您不能在战斗中再次使用本计谋。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DEVIOUS SCHEME
Schemers all, the Drukhari are used to staying one
step ahead of their opponents and confounding their
every move.
Use this firefight ploy after an opponent uses a
firefight ploy (excluding one that costs 0CP). The
next time they would use that ploy, they must
spend 1 additional CP to do so (at which point
this effect ends). You cannot use this ploy again
during the battle until its effect has ended.

cards.text:
执政官之手
交战计谋
可憎傲慢
对于傲慢的黑暗灵族来说，所有对手都只不过
是害虫而已——要么无视，要么完全消灭。
在轮到您激活己方特工时使用本交战计谋。您可
以跳过那次激活。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
HEINOUS ARROGANCE
To the conceited Drukhari, all opponents are little more
than vermin – to be ignored or exterminated.
Use this firefight ploy when it’s your turn to
activate a friendly operative. You can skip
that activation.

cards.text:
执政官之手
交战计谋
掠食伤者
黑暗灵族被痛苦所吸引，他们会搜寻伤者并赐
予他们致命一击。
当己方执政官之手特工对处于受伤状态的敌方
特工进行射击或近战时，在您掷攻击骰后使用本
计谋。您可以重掷任何自己的攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PREY ON THE WOUNDED
Drukhari are drawn to agony, seeking out the injured to
land a killing blow.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operative,
if it’s shooting against or fighting against a
wounded enemy operative. You can re-roll any of
your attack dice.

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营装备
链式陷阱
一系列倒钩被安置在了锁链上，这件武器能
够刺入血肉或护甲之中，阻止使用者的目标
逃跑。
每当一名位于己方执政官之手特工控制范围
内的敌方特工执行后撤行动时，如果那名己方特
工的控制范围内不存在其他敌方特工，那么您可
以使用本规则。若使用，则掷两枚 D6，如果那
名敌方特工的耐伤属性大于己方特工，则掷一枚
D6。若任意结果结果为 4+，那么那名敌方特工
不能在那次激活或反应期间执行那个行动（不消
耗任何 AP)，并且在这个转折点中你不能再次使
用这个规则。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHAIN SNARE
Composed of hooked blades attached to a length of
chain, this weapon bites into the flesh or armour of the
wielder’s target, preventing them from fleeing.
Whenever an enemy operative would perform the
Fall Back action while within control range of a
friendly HAND OF THE ARCHON operative, if no
other enemy operatives are within that friendly
operative’s control range, you can use this rule.
If you do, roll two D6, or one D6 if that enemy
operative has a higher Wounds stat than that
friendly operative. If any result is a 4+, that enemy
operative cannot perform that action during that
activation/counteraction (no AP are spent on it),
and you cannot use this rule again during this
turning point.

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营装备
凶险利刃
这些锯齿利刃轻便且致命，能够保证在刺入
受害者的血肉时产生最大的痛苦。
己方执政官之手特工成套刀具武器的攻击属性
提升 1 点。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
WICKED BLADES
Light yet deadly, the jagged edge of this blade has been
crafted to ensure maximum agony as it’s plunged into
the flesh of a victim.
Add 1 to the Atk stat of friendly HAND OF THE
ARCHON operatives’ array of blades.

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营装备
剧毒涂层
黑暗灵族掠夺者们时常会在自己的武器上涂
上毒液，确保哪怕只是轻微的擦伤也能够将
目标置于死地。
每个转折点限两次，每当一名己方执政官之手
特工进行近战和反击时，您可以在选择近战武器
时使用本规则。若使用，那么直到流程结束前，
那名特工的近战武器拥有“致命 5+”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TOXIN COATING
Drukhari raiders are known to coat their blades in
venom, ensuring that even the slightest nick of blade
against flesh is fatal.
Up to twice per turning point, whenever a friendly
HAND OF THE ARCHON operative is fighting or
retaliating and you’re selecting a melee weapon,
you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of
that sequence, that operative’s melee weapon
has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.

cards.text:
执政官之手
阵营装备
精炼毒药
这些毒晶弹药中蕴藏着从危险生物和植物身
上提取而出的剧毒，比常见毒药更加致命。
每个转折点限两次，每当一名己方执政官之手
特工执行射击行动时，如果您选择了一件毒晶卡
宾枪、毒晶炮、毒晶手枪或毒晶步枪，那么您可
以使用本规则。若使用，那么直到那次行动结束
前，那件武器的普通伤害属性提升 1 点。
cards.text_en:
HAND OF THE ARCHON
FACTION EQUIPMENT
REFINED POISON
Splinter rounds are infused with exquisitely lethal
concoctions distilled from the potent venoms and toxins
of deadly flora and fauna.
Up to twice per turning point, whenever a friendly
HAND OF THE ARCHON operative is performing
the Shoot action and you select a shardcarbine,
splinter cannon, splinter pistol, splinter rifle or
stinger pistol, you can use this rule. If you do, until
the end of that action, add 1 to the Normal Dmg
stat of that weapon.
